breakdown.description: The traction-free hole boundary is replaced by an artificial radial displacement constraint
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the contradiction regarding the hole boundary condition. The generated text includes both the correct instruction ('Set the hole boundary... as traction-free') and the incorrect instruction from the original prompt ('Additionally, impose zero normal displacement on the hole boundary...'). The ground truth explicitly removes the incorrect displacement constraint, leaving the boundary only as traction-free. The agent repeated the user's error.
